headline: 🔴 Gitea RCE added to CISA KEV, 🔓 OpenSSL patches 9 CVEs including QUIC double-free, 📦 npm mirror supply chain hijack, 🔑 WordPress TranslatePress unauthenticated takeover, 🗂️ 28K exposed .git repos leak cloud creds, 🏛️ CISA Red Team pwns AD in critical infra
summary: Gitea CVE-2026-60004 confirmed exploited in the wild and added to CISA KEV; OpenSSL disclosed nine vulnerabilities including a QUIC double-free; attackers exploit npm mirror infrastructure for ClickFix phishing; WordPress TranslatePress flaw exposes password-reset keys to unauthenticated attackers; 28,000 internet-facing .git repositories leak active cloud credentials; CISA red team achieved full domain compromise at two critical-infrastructure organizations through common AD misconfigurations.
